name: Tolrestat

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market worldwide, first in 1996 — for liver harm

summary: Tolrestat was removed from the worldwide market beginning in 1996 due to harm caused to the liver [3]. In addition, a small computer model evaluated the drug rather than tests on people, giving it a medium score of 53 for liver risk and a low score of 25 for heart risk [M]. These computer ratings and past records highlight the specific areas of concern noted for the drug [3][M].
